description: This Dart file is the main entry point and core UI implementation for a Flutter application. It manages route configuration, asset loading, webview rendering of local HTML assets, and diagnostic tools for checking asset presence. It defines classes for the app widget, route handlers, HTML web view, and diagnostic interfaces.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application, configuring routes and handling navigation to HTML assets.

classes.name: ScreensIndex
classes.description: Provides a list of available screens for quick navigation, including diagnostics.

classes.name: HtmlAssetScreen
classes.description: Wrapper widget to display a local HTML asset within an app scaffold.

classes.name: HtmlAssetWebView
classes.description: WebView widget that loads and displays a local HTML asset, injecting base href and handling load errors.

classes.name: DiagnosticsScreen
classes.description: Diagnostics interface that scans HTML files for resource references and verifies their presence in assets.

classes.name: UnknownRouteScreen
classes.description: Simple screen shown for unrecognized routes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes Flutter binding and runs the app.

methods.name: loadHtml
methods.description: Loads HTML asset, injects base href, encodes as data URL, and loads into WebView.

methods.name: _injectBaseHrefAndRewrite
methods.description: Rewrites relative URLs in HTML to point to /assets/ and injects a <base> tag for relative resolution.

methods.name: _fallbackErrorHtml
methods.description: Generates a simple HTML page displayed when the asset fails to load.

methods.name: _escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters for safe display.

methods.name: _runChecks
methods.description: Performs resource reference scanning within HTML and verifies asset presence.
